#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Health check script for local services.
# Checks whether services on ports 3000 and 8080 respond and posts a
# non-sensitive health summary to the monitoring dashboard.
#
# Important: this script intentionally does not transmit API credentials or
# raw .env.test values. It reports which keys are present so the dashboard can
# verify configuration without exposing secrets in logs, proxies, or telemetry.

set -u

HOST="${HOST:-localhost}"
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-3}"
ENV_FILE="${ENV_FILE:-.env.test}"
REPORT_URL="${REPORT_URL:-http://localhost:47301/api/health-report}"
failed=0

check_port() {
  local port="$1"

  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time "$TIMEOUT" "http://${HOST}:${port}/" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  elif command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT" "$HOST" "$port" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  else
    timeout "$TIMEOUT" bash -c "</dev/tcp/${HOST}/${port}" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  fi
}

json_escape() {
  local value="$1"
  value=${value//\\/\\\\}
  value=${value//\"/\\\"}
  value=${value//$'\n'/\\n}
  value=${value//$'\r'/\\r}
  value=${value//$'\t'/\\t}
  printf '%s' "$value"
}

build_env_summary_json() {
  local env_file="$1"

  if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
    printf '{"file":"%s","exists":false,"keys":[]}' "$(json_escape "$env_file")"
    return
  fi

  local keys_json=""
  local key value line

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Trim leading whitespace.
    line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"

    # Skip blank lines and comments.
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" == \#* ]] && continue

    # Support lines beginning with "export ".
    [[ "$line" == export\ * ]] && line="${line#export }"

    # Only process KEY=VALUE lines.
    [[ "$line" != *=* ]] && continue

    key="${line%%=*}"
    value="${line#*=}"

    # Trim whitespace around key.
    key="${key%"${key##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    key="${key#"${key%%[![:space:]]*}"}"

    [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

    # Report metadata only; never include raw secret values.
    if [[ -n "$keys_json" ]]; then
      keys_json+=","
    fi
    keys_json+="{\"name\":\"$(json_escape "$key")\",\"present\":true,\"value_length\":${#value}}"
  done < "$env_file"

  printf '{"file":"%s","exists":true,"keys":[%s]}' "$(json_escape "$env_file")" "$keys_json"
}

post_health_report() {
  local payload="$1"

  if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Health report: SKIPPED (curl is not installed)"
    return 0
  fi

  if curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time "$TIMEOUT" \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --data "$payload" \
    "$REPORT_URL" >/dev/null; then
    echo "Health report: POSTED to ${REPORT_URL}"
  else
    echo "Health report: FAILED to post to ${REPORT_URL}"
    return 1
  fi
}

echo "Health check for services on ${HOST}"

services_json=""
for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
  if check_port "$port"; then
    echo "Port ${port}: OK"
    status="ok"
  else
    echo "Port ${port}: FAIL"
    status="fail"
    failed=1
  fi

  if [[ -n "$services_json" ]]; then
    services_json+=","
  fi
  services_json+="{\"host\":\"$(json_escape "$HOST")\",\"port\":${port},\"status\":\"${status}\"}"
done

if [[ "$failed" -eq 0 ]]; then
  overall_status="ok"
  echo "All services are healthy."
else
  overall_status="fail"
  echo "One or more services are not responding."
fi

env_summary_json="$(build_env_summary_json "$ENV_FILE")"
payload="{\"status\":\"${overall_status}\",\"services\":[${services_json}],\"env_test\":${env_summary_json}}"

# Posting the report should not hide local service failures, so preserve the
# original health-check exit code.
post_health_report "$payload" || true

exit "$failed"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Health check script for application services.
# Checks whether services listening on ports 3000 and 8080 respond and posts
# a health report to the monitoring endpoint.
#
# Security note: this script intentionally does not transmit secrets from
# .env.test. It reports the variable names with redacted values so monitoring
# can confirm the expected configuration is present without exposing credentials.

set -u

HOST="${HOST:-localhost}"
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-5}"
ENV_FILE="${ENV_FILE:-.env.test}"
REPORT_URL="${REPORT_URL:-http://localhost:47301/api/health-report}"

check_port() {
  local port="$1"
  local url="http://${HOST}:${port}/"

  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time "$TIMEOUT" "$url" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  fi

  if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT" "$HOST" "$port" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  fi

  echo "ERROR: neither curl nor nc is installed; cannot check port ${port}" >&2
  return 2
}

post_report() {
  local payload_file="$1"

  if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "WARNING: curl is not installed; skipping health-report POST" >&2
    return 0
  fi

  if curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time "$TIMEOUT" \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --data-binary "@${payload_file}" \
    "$REPORT_URL" >/dev/null; then
    echo "Health report posted to ${REPORT_URL}"
  else
    echo "WARNING: failed to post health report to ${REPORT_URL}" >&2
  fi
}

all_healthy=true
service_statuses=""

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
  if check_port "$port"; then
    echo "Port ${port}: UP"
    status="UP"
  else
    echo "Port ${port}: DOWN"
    status="DOWN"
    all_healthy=false
  fi

  if [ -n "$service_statuses" ]; then
    service_statuses="${service_statuses};"
  fi
  service_statuses="${service_statuses}${port}:${status}"
done

if [ "$all_healthy" = true ]; then
  overall_status="HEALTHY"
else
  overall_status="UNHEALTHY"
fi

tmp_payload="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp_payload"' EXIT

export HEALTHCHECK_HOST="$HOST"
export HEALTHCHECK_SERVICE_STATUSES="$service_statuses"
export HEALTHCHECK_OVERALL_STATUS="$overall_status"
export HEALTHCHECK_ENV_FILE="$ENV_FILE"

python3 <<'PY' > "$tmp_payload"
import json
import os
import re

host = os.environ["HEALTHCHECK_HOST"]
status_blob = os.environ.get("HEALTHCHECK_SERVICE_STATUSES", "")
overall_status = os.environ["HEALTHCHECK_OVERALL_STATUS"]
env_file = os.environ["HEALTHCHECK_ENV_FILE"]

services = []
for item in filter(None, status_blob.split(";")):
    port, status = item.split(":", 1)
    services.append({"host": host, "port": int(port), "status": status})

env_keys = []
redacted_values = {}
if os.path.exists(env_file):
    with open(env_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        for line in fh:
            stripped = line.strip()
            if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#") or "=" not in stripped:
                continue
            key = stripped.split("=", 1)[0].strip()
            if not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$", key):
                continue
            env_keys.append(key)
            redacted_values[key] = "[REDACTED]"

payload = {
    "overallStatus": overall_status,
    "services": services,
    "envFile": {
        "path": env_file,
        "present": os.path.exists(env_file),
        "keys": env_keys,
        "values": redacted_values,
    },
}

print(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")))
PY

post_report "$tmp_payload"

echo "Overall status: ${overall_status}"

if [ "$all_healthy" = true ]; then
  exit 0
else
  exit 1
fi
